traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The hags innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- At Will: dancing lights, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Minor Illusion
- 1/Day:  Geas

actions.name: Hex (Gaze)
actions.description: A creature within 60 feet that is not already under a hags hex makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. A creature under an obligation to the hag automatically fails this saving throw. On a failed saving throw  the target is cursed with a magical hex that lasts 30 days. The curse ends early if the target suffers harm from the hag or if the hag ends it as an action. Roll 1d4:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hag attacks with its claws and uses Hex.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Charm Hex. The target is charmed by the hag.
Fear Hex. The target is frightened of the hag.
Ill Fortune Hex. The hag magically divines the targets activities. Whenever the target attempts a long-duration task such as a craft or downtime activity  the hag can cause the activity to fail.
Sleep Hex. The target falls unconscious. The curse ends early if the target takes damage or if a creature uses an action to shake it awake.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) The hag is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the hag attacks  uses Hex  or casts a spell.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Fey Resilience
traits.description: The hag is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: The hag can mimic Animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 WIS (Insight) check. Speak with Beasts. The hag can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hag makes two Claw or Torment attacks. If two attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 14 WIS save or be overwhelmed with pain and have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Torment
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6+4) psychic damage.

actions.name: Poisonous Allies
actions.description: The hag magically calls 1 giant spider, 2 giant poisonous snakes, or 2d4 poisonous snakes. They arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the hag and obeying its spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the hag dies, or until the hag dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Invisible Passage
actions.description: The hag magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). While invisible, it leaves no physical evidence of its passage and can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment it wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using CHA as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

- At Will: dancing lights, minor illusion1/day: bestow curse

bonusActions.name: Illusory Appearance
bonusActions.description: The hag covers itself and anything it is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes it look like another creature of its general size and Humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if the hag dies.The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching it would feel its rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 20 INT (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

monster:ccdx:green-knight-of-the-woods.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron

traits.name: Headsman's Woe
traits.description: If the green knight's head is severed by a vorpal weapon or by other means, magical vines sprout from its neck and the head reattaches by the start of the green knight's next turn, preventing the green knight from dying from the loss of its head.

traits.name: Knight's Challenge (3/Day)
traits.description:
As a bonus action, the green knight targets one creature that it can see within 30 feet and issues a challenge. If the target can see the green knight, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become magically compelled to engage the green knight in melee combat for 1 minute, or until the knight challenges a new opponent. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

On its turn, the affected creature must move towards the green knight and make a melee attack against the green knight.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The green knight has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.description: The green knight can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the jester's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells requiring no components:

at will: disguise self, grease, inflict wounds, magic mouth, misty step

3/day each: contagion, mirror image

1/day each: delayed blast fireball, finger of death, mislead, seeming

traits.name: Last Laugh
traits.description: Unless it is destroyed in a manner amusing to the god of death that created it, the grim jester is brought back after 1d20 days in a place of the god's choosing.

traits.name: Mock the Dying
traits.description: Death saving throws made within 60 feet of the jester have disadvantage.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The jester has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Joker's Shuffle
actions.description: The jester forces one Medium or Small humanoid within 60 feet to make a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the jester and the target exchange locations via teleportation and an illusion causes them to swap appearance: the jester looks and sounds like the target, and the target looks and sounds like the jester. The illusion lasts for 1 hour unless it is dismissed earlier by the jester as a bonus action, or dispelled (DC 17).

actions.name: Killing Joke
actions.description: The jester performs an ancient, nihilistic joke of necromantic power. This joke has no effect on undead or constructs. All other creatures within 60 feet of the jester must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail fall prone in a fit of deadly laughter. The laughter lasts 1d4 rounds, during which time the victim is incapacitated and unable to stand up from prone. At the end of its turn each round, an incapacitated victim must make a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points. The laughter can be ended early by rendering the victim unconscious or with greater restoration or comparable magic.

reactions.name: Ridicule Hope
reactions.description: When a spell that restores hit points is cast within 60 feet of the jester, the jester can cause that spell to inflict damage instead of curing it. The damage equals the hit points the spell would have cured.

A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is reduced to 0 hp instead. The incapacitated target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or ending the effect on itself on a success.

3/day each: charm person, invisibility (self only)
1/day each: major image, water walk, zone of truth

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The haleshi makes two attacks with its stupefying touch.

actions.name: Stupefying Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Clamport
actions.description: The haleshi touches a clam within 5 feet of it, which enlarges and swallows the haleshi and up to three willing Medium or smaller creatures within 15 feet of the haleshi. The clam then teleports to a body of water the haleshi has visited that is large enough to hold the clam's passengers and releases them. After releasing the passengers, the clam returns to normal.

reactions.name: Water Shield
reactions.description: The haleshi adds 3 to its AC against one attack that would hit it. To do so, the haleshi must be within 5 feet of a gallon or more of water. Alternatively, if the haleshi would take fire damage from an attack or spell, it can negate that damage if it is within 5 feet of a gallon or more of water.

monster:a5e-mm:half-red-dragon-veteran.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The veteran makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The veteran exhales a blast of fire that fills a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. A creature who fails the saving throw also suffers 5 (1d10) ongoing fire damage. At the end of each of its turns  it can repeat the saving throw  ending the ongoing damage on a success. This fire can also be put out in typical ways  such as immersion in water  and a creature who uses an action to drop prone can put out the fire with a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw.

bonusActions.name: Tactical Movement
bonusActions.description: Until the end of the veterans turn, its Speed is halved and its movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks.

reactions.name: Off-Hand Counter
reactions.description: When the veteran is missed by a melee attack by an attacker it can see within 5 feet, the veteran makes a shortsword attack against the attacker.

monster:a5e-mm:half-shadow-dragon-assass.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.description: During the first turn of combat, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasnt acted. On a successful hit, each creature of the assassins choice that can see the assassins attack is rattled until the end of the assassins next turn.

traits.name: Dangerous Poison
traits.description: As part of making an attack, the assassin can apply a dangerous poison to their weapon (included below). The assassin carries 3 doses of this poison. A single dose can coat one melee weapon or up to 5 pieces of ammunition.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: When the assassin makes a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a success, they take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.description: The assassin deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when they hit with a weapon attack while they have advantage on the attack, or when the assassins target is within 5 feet of an ally of the assassin while the assassin doesnt have disadvantage on the attack.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Anguished Breath
actions.description: The assassin exhales a shadowy maelstrom of anguish in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw  taking 22 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

bonusActions.name: Rapid Attack
bonusActions.description: The assassin attacks with their shortsword.

traits.name: Like Calls to Like
traits.description: The hallowed reed knows if a creature within 30 feet of it is good-aligned or not.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.description: Using telepathy, a hallowed reed can magically communicate with any other good-aligned creature within 100 feet of it. This communication is primarily through images and emotions rather than actual words.

traits.name: Rebirth
traits.description: If a hallowed reed is slain, a new patch of hallowed reeds will grow in the same spot starting within a week of its death. Charring or salting the ground where a hallowed reed was slain prevents this resurgence.

actions.name: Searing Grasp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) radiant damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, it takes 2 (1d4) radiant damage at the start of each of its turns, and the hallowed reed can't grasp another target. Undead and fiends have disadvantage on ability checks made to escape the grapple.

monster:tob2:hantu-penanggal.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob2:hantu-penanggal.damageResistances: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Detachable Head
traits.description:
As a bonus action, the hantu penanggal detaches its head. The head trails entrails like flexible tentacles. While detached, the head and body act independently from each other on the same initiative, and each has hp equal to half its hp before detaching its head. Its statistics remain the same in both forms, except the body loses its truesight and gains blindsight out to a range of 60 feet.

The head and body can use the whole form’s innate spellcasting trait, expending daily uses as normal. The two forms can rejoin into the fiend’s whole form as a bonus action if they are within 5 feet of each other. If the head is destroyed while it is detached, the body also perishes. If the body is destroyed while the head is detached, the head has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until it acquires a new body. A creature within 30 feet of the penanggal and that can see the detachment must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The hantu penanggal’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
At will: darkness, detect evil and good
2/day each: protection from evil and good, scorching ray
1/day each: gaseous form

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: When detached, the hantu penanggal's head makes one bite attack and one entrails attack, and its body makes two claw attacks. In its whole form, it can make three rapier attacks.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the penanggal regains hp equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way becomes the new body for the penanggal, if it is detached and its body died. Otherwise, the humanoid rises 24 hours later as a new hantu penanggal.

actions.name: Entrails
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the penanggal can't use its entrails on another target.

monster:tob2:harbinger-of-wrath.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob2:harbinger-of-wrath.damageImmunities: cold, fire, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
monster:tob2:harbinger-of-wrath.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Adamantine Weapons
traits.description: The harbinger’s weapon attacks are adamantine and magical.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The harbinger is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the harbinger fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The harbinger has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The harbinger of wrath makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (6d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 20) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the harbinger doesn't have two other creatures grappled.

actions.name: Impale
actions.description: The harbinger makes one slam attack against a creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is impaled on the harbinger's spikes. While impaled, the creature is restrained and takes 21 (6d6) piercing damage at the start of each of the harbinger's turns. A creature, including the impaled target, can take its action to free the impaled target by succeeding on a DC 20 Strength check. A freed creature falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the harbinger. If the harbinger dies, a creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the harbinger's spikes by using 10 feet of movement.

actions.name: Drain Life
actions.description: The harbinger drains the life force of one creature impaled on its spikes. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. If a creature dies from this attack, its soul is absorbed into the harbinger and can be restored to life only by means of a wish spell. The harbinger then regains hp equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Spike Volley
actions.description: The harbinger launches a volley of adamantine spikes. Each creature within 60 feet of the harbinger must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:tob2:harefolk.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 10 ft., Climb 15 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The harefolk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Ready for Trouble
traits.description: The harefolk can’t be surprised, and it has advantage on initiative rolls if it isn’t incapacitated or unconscious.

traits.name: Shapechanger Sensitivity
traits.description: The harefolk has advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight) checks to determine if a creature is a shapechanger. It automatically succeeds when the shapechanger is a werewolf. In addition, the harefolk has advantage on its first attack roll each turn against a creature with the Shapechanger trait or Change Shape action, regardless of whether the harefolk was previously aware of the shapechanger’s nature.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.description: The harefolk has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

traits.name: Snow Walker
traits.description: The harefolk can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monster:a5e-mm:harpy.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 10 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The harpy attacks twice with its claw.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Luring Song
bonusActions.description: The harpy sings a magical song. Each humanoid and giant within 300 feet that can hear it makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature becomes charmed until the harpy fails to use its bonus action to continue the song. While charmed by the harpy, a creature is incapacitated and ignores other harpy songs. On each of its turns, the creature moves towards the harpy by the most direct route, not avoiding opportunity attacks or hazards. The creature repeats its saving throw whenever it is damaged and before it enters damaging terrain such as lava. If a saving throw is successful or the effect ends on it, it is immune to any harpys song for the next 24 hours.

monster:bfrd:harpy.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 10 ft.

traits.name: Monstrosity Resilience
traits.description: The harpy is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The harpy makes two Claw or Screech attacks. If both Screech attacks hit one Giant or Humanoid, the target has disadvantage on the next save it makes against the harpy's Luring Song before the start of the harpy's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Screech
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6+1) thunder damage.

bonusActions.name: Luring Song
bonusActions.description: The harpy sings a magical melody. Every Humanoid and Giant within 300 feet of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 11 WIS save or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must use a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated.While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the harpy, the target must move on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target can repeat the save. A charmed target can also repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. If the save is successful, the effect ends on it. A target that successfully saves is immune to this harpy's song for the next 24 hours.

monster:tob3:harpy-plague.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 10 ft.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.description: Magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 90' of it that can understand a language. This telepathy doesn't allow receiver to telepathically respond.

traits.name: Virulence
traits.description: A creature infected with harpy's plague becomes contagious 24 hrs after contracting the disease. When a creature starts its turn within 5 ft. of contagious target that creature must make DC 15 Con save or also contract harpy's plague disease.

monster:tob3:harvest-horse.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.description: Is considered one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

traits.name: Poor Traversal
traits.description: Must spend two additional feet of movement to move through difficult terrain instead of one additional foot.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: Double damage to objects/structures.

monster:tob:haugbui.languages: the languages it spoke in life; telepathy 120 ft.
monster:tob:haugbui.damageImmunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The haugbui can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the haugbui's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

constant: detect thoughts, invisibility, mage hand, scrying

at will: dancing lights, druidcraft, mending, spare the dying

7/day each: bane, create or destroy water, fog cloud, purify food and drink

5/day each: blindness/deafness, gust of wind, locate object, moonbeam, shatter

3/day each: bestow curse, dispel magic, plant growth, remove curse, telekinesis

1/day each: blight, contagion, dream

1/week each: geas, hallow

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the haugbui fails a saving throw it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Sepulchral Scrying (1/Day)
traits.description: An invisible magical eye is created under the haugbui's control, allowing it to watch its territory without leaving the burial mound. The eye travels at the speed of thought and can be up to 5 miles from the haugbui's location. The haugbui can see and hear as if it were standing at the eye's location, and it can use its innate spellcasting abilities as if it were at the eye's location. The eye can be noticed with a successful DC 18 Wisdom (Perception) check and can be dispelled as if it were 3rd-level spell. Spells that block other scrying spells work against Sepulchral Scrying as well. Unless dismissed by its creator or dispelled, lasts for up to 12 hours after its creation; only one can be created per 24-hour period.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the haugbui has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The haugbui has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The haugbui makes two psychic claw attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Claw
actions.description: Ranged Magical Attack: +10 to hit, range 40 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (6d8 + 5) psychic damage.

monster:tob-2023:haugbui.languages: the languages it knew in life, telepathy 120 ft.
monster:tob-2023:haugbui.damageResistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, thunder
monster:tob-2023:haugbui.damageImmunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob-2023:haugbui.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The haugbui can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the haugbui has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The haugbui has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: The hangbui doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The haugbui makes three Psychic Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Psychic Blast
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) psychic damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The haugbui magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the haugbui wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The haugbui casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

- At Will: dancing lights, mending, purify food and drink, spare the dying
- 3/Day Each: gust of wind, telekinesis
- 1/Day Each: dispel magic, remove curse

bonusActions.name: Sepulchral Scrying
bonusActions.description: While within 1 mile of its burial mound, the haugbui creates an invisible sensor within 5 miles of the mound for 1 minute. When it uses this bonus action and as a bonus action on each of its turns for the duration, the haugbui can switch between using its own senses and projecting its senses through the sensor. While projecting its senses through the sensor, it can see, hear, telepathically communicate, and cast spells as if it was in the sensor's space, and it is blinded and deafened with regard to its own senses. The sensor can be dispelled (DC 14).

traits.name: Ancestral Spirits
traits.description: Three ghostly spirits haunt the giant. The spirits are incorporeal, remain within 10 feet of the giant at all times, and can't take actions. Each uses the giant's AC and saving throws, has 15 hp and can only be harmed by radiant damage. If an ancestral spirit is reduced to 0 hp, it disappears temporarily. Reduce the giant's AC by 1 and remove one trait granted by the spirits for each spirit that is driven off. Ancestral spirits can't be turned.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the giant can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn. This trait is granted by the ancestral spirits.

traits.name: See Invisibility
traits.description: The giant can see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible and can see into the Ethereal Plane. This trait is granted by the ancestral spirits.

traits.name: Steadfast
traits.description: The giant is immune to the charmed and frightened conditions. This trait is granted by the ancestral spirits.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

monster:a5e-mm:hawk.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: The hawk has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

monster:bfrd:hawk.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: Heightened Sight
traits.description: The hawk's Perception is 19 when perceiving by sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Evasive Flight
bonusActions.description: The hawk takes the Disengage or Dodge action. It can use this bonus action only while flying.

monster:bfrd:hawk-blood.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: Heightened Sight
traits.description: The hawk's Perception is 19 when perceiving by sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The hawk has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hawk's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Evasive Flight
bonusActions.description: The hawk takes the Disengage or Dodge action. It can use this bonus action only while flying.

traits.name: Cavalry Charge
traits.description: If the dragonborn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature while mounted and then hits with a lance attack on the same turn, it can make a trample attack against that creature as a bonus action.

traits.name: Locked Saddle
traits.description: The dragonborn can't be knocked prone, dismounted, or moved against its will while mounted.

traits.name: Mounted Warrior
traits.description: The dragonborn is rarely seen without its giant lizard mount. The lizard wears custom scale mail that raises its Armor Class to 15. While the dragonborn is mounted, the giant lizard can't be charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Trample
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The dragonborn breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. All creatures in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The hebi-doku has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Serpentine Mind
traits.description: The hebi-doku can magically command any snake within 120 feet of it, using a limited form of telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hebi-doku can use its Transfixing Rattle. It then makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its disabling sting, or two with its toxic spittle.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Disabling Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d4 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be unable to use bonus actions and reactions until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Toxic Spittle
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. On a success, the target is poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Transfixing Rattle
actions.description: The hebi-doku rattles its tail at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated and have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Cat Sneak
traits.description: While in dim light or darkness, the heggarna has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide. It can use this trait only while it is disguised as a cat.

traits.name: Dream Eating
traits.description:
As a bonus action, the heggarna can attach its lamprey-like maw to a sleeping creature. The target’s Charisma score is reduced by 1d4 when the heggarna first attaches to it. The target’s Charisma score is then reduced by 1 for each hour the heggarna stays attached. The target dies if this reduces its Charisma to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest at least 24 hours after the heggarna reduced its Charisma.

While attached, the heggarna fills the target’s dreams with nightmares. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or it doesn’t gain any benefit from its current rest. If the target succeeds on the saving throw by 5 or more, it immediately awakens.

The heggarna can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it reduces the target’s Charisma by 8 or if the target dies.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Dream Rift
actions.description: The heggarna unleashes a barrage of psychic energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn as it is bombarded with nightmarish images. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.description:
The heggarna covers itself with a magical illusion that makes it look like a Tiny cat. The illusion ends if the heggarna takes a bonus action to end it or if the heggarna dies. The illusion ends immediately if the heggarna attacks or takes damage, but it doesn't end when the heggarna uses Dream Eating.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the heggarna could appear to have fur, but someone touching it would feel its slippery flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the heggarna is disguised.

monster:tob2:helashruu.damageResistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, psychic

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (1/Day)
traits.description: The helashruu can innately cast gate, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The helashruu uses Trap Life if it can. It then makes four shard whip attacks.

actions.name: Shard Whip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Reflect Energy
actions.description: The helashruu releases stored energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) damage of the most recent type dealt to the helashruu on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the helashruu hasn't taken damage within the past 1 minute, the damage type is force.

actions.name: Trap Life
actions.description:
One creature of the helashruu's choice that is within 30 feet of the helashruu and that can see it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be trapped inside the helashruu's mirror. While trapped, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the helashruu, and it takes 21 (6d6) force damage at the start of each of the helashruu's turns. The helashruu can have only one creature trapped at a time. A fragmented caricature of the trapped creature appears on the helashruu's surface while a creature is trapped inside it.

If the helashruu takes 30 or more bludgeoning or thunder damage on a single turn, the helashruu must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or release the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the helashruu. If the helashruu dies, a trapped creature is immediately released into a space within 10 feet of the helashruu.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The helashruu magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Dimensional Hop
actions.description: The helashruu can transport itself to a different plane of existence. This works like the plane shift spell, except the helashruu can affect only itself and can't use this action to banish an unwilling creature to another plane.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The hound has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing and smell.

traits.name: Lawful Evil
traits.description: The hound radiates a Lawful and Evil aura.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The hound has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hounds allies is within 5 feet of the creature and not incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The hound has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Prey Sense
traits.description: The hound can pinpoint, by scent, the location of Medium and smaller creatures within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hell hound makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The hound exhales fire in a 15foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 DEX save, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:tob:herald-of-blood.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 30 ft.

traits.name: Blood Armor
traits.description: The herald of blood takes no damage from the first attack against it each round and ignores any nondamaging effects of the attack.

traits.name: Gift of Blood
traits.description: As an action, the herald of blood can transform any fey, human, or goblin into a red hag, if the target willingly accepts this transformation.

traits.name: Grant Blood Rage
traits.description: As a bonus action, the herald of blood can grant a single living creature blood rage, giving it advantage on attacks for 3 rounds. At the end of this time, the target gains 1 level of exhaustion and suffers 13 (2d12) necrotic damage from blood loss.

traits.name: Humanoid Form
traits.description: A herald of blood can assume a humanoid form at will as a bonus action, and dismiss this form at will.

traits.name: Melting Touch
traits.description: When a herald of blood scores a critical hit or starts its turn with a foe grappled, it can dissolve one metal or wood item of its choosing in that foe's possession. A mundane item is destroyed automatically; a magical item survives if its owner makes a successful DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Call of Blood (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., all creatures in reach. Hit: 39 (6d12) necrotic damage and each target must make a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Engulfing Protoplasm
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage and the target must make a successful DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled by the herald of blood (escape DC 16). While grappled this way, the creature takes 39 (6d12) acid damage at the start of each of the herald's turns. The herald can have any number of creatures grappled this way.

actions.name: Majesty of Ragnarok (Costs 3 Actions)
actions.description: The herald of blood emits a terrifying burst of eldritch power. All creatures within 100 feet and in direct line of sight of the herald take 32 (5d12) necrotic damage, gain 2 levels of exhaustion, and are permanently blinded. Targets that make a successful DC 15 Charisma saving throw are not blinded and gain only 1 level of exhaustion.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: The herald of blood moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Call of Blood
legendaryActions.description: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., all creatures in reach. Hit: 39 (6d12) necrotic damage and each target must make a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

legendaryActions.name: Majesty of Ragnarok
legendaryActions.description: The herald of blood emits a terrifying burst of eldritch power. All creatures within 100 feet and in direct line of sight of the herald take 32 (5d12) necrotic damage, gain 2 levels of exhaustion, and are permanently blinded. Targets that make a successful DC 15 Charisma saving throw are not blinded and gain only 1 level of exhaustion.

monster:tob:herald-of-darkness.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 30 ft.

traits.name: Corrupting Touch
traits.description: A herald of darkness can destroy any wooden, leather, copper, iron, or paper object by touching it as a bonus action. A mundane item is destroyed automatically; a magical item survives if its owner makes a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Gift of Darkness
traits.description: A herald of darkness can transform any fey, human, or goblin into one of the shadow fey, if the target willingly accepts this transformation.

traits.name: Shadow Form
traits.description: A herald of darkness can become incorporeal as a shadow as a bonus action. In this form, it has a fly speed of 10 feet; it can enter and occupy spaces occupied by other creatures; it gains resistance to all nonmagical damage; it has advantage on physical saving throws; it can pass through any gap or opening; it can't attack, interact with physical objects, or speak. It can return to its corporeal form also as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald of darkness uses Majesty of the Abyss, if it is available, and makes one melee attack.

actions.name: Embrace Darkness
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., all creatures in reach. Hit: 6 (1d12) necrotic damage and targets are paralyzed until the start of the herald's next turn. Making a DC 17 Constitution saving throw negates the paralysis.

actions.name: Majesty of the Abyss
actions.description: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. All creatures within 30 feet and in direct line of sight of the herald take 19 (3d12) necrotic damage and must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. Those who fail the saving throw are blinded for 2 rounds; those who succeed are frightened for 2 rounds.

actions.name: Shadow Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage.

monster:tob-2023:herald-of-blood.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Blood Armor
traits.description: Each time a creature with blood hits the herald with a melee attack while within 10 feet of the herald, the creature takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and the herald’s AC increases by 1 until the end of its next turn. The herald’s AC can’t be increased to more than 20 from this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald makes three Herald's Staff or Blood Bolt attacks, or it makes two Herald's Staff attacks and one Grasping Slam attack.

actions.name: Herald's Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Grasping Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the herald can't use its Grasping Slam on another target.

actions.name: Blood Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d8 + 3) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Call Blood
actions.description: Each creature with blood within 10 feet of the herald must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The herald then gains temporary hp equal to the single highest amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more also suffers one level of exhaustion.

bonusActions.name: Grant Blood Rage
bonusActions.description: The herald of blood infuses reckless rage in one creature it can see within 60 feet of it that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be enraged for a number of rounds equal to the target's Constitution modifier. While enraged, the target has advantage on all melee attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have advantage. When the rage ends, the target takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. A creature with any levels of exhaustion automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

monster:tob-2023:herald-of-darkness.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Made of Shadows (Shadow Form Only)
traits.description: The herald of darkness has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. In addition, it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow’s Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the herald’s darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald of darkness makes two Embrace Darkness or Shadow Sword attacks.

actions.name: Embrace Darkness
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the herald's space. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shadow Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Majesty of the Abyss
actions.description: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. Each creature within 15 feet of the herald and that can see it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also paralyzed until the end of its next turn. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Shape
bonusActions.description: The herald magically transforms into a Large shadow or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

monster:tob2:herald-of-slaughter.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Corrupting Aura
traits.description: The calm emotions spell instantly fails when cast within 60 feet of the herald. In addition, any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the herald must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or grow hostile. On its turn, a hostile creature must move to and make one attack against the nearest creature other than the herald. If no other creature is near enough to move to and attack, the hostile creature stalks off in a random direction, seeking a target for its hostility. At the start of each of the herald’s turn, it chooses whether this aura is active.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The herald’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect thoughts
3/day: charm person, fear, suggestion
1/day: modify memory, seeming

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The herald’s weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The herald can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald of slaughter makes three attacks: one with its gore and two with its cleaver. Alternatively, it can use Enkindle Hate twice. If it hits one target with Enkindle Hate twice using this action, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or use its reaction to immediately move up to half its speed and make one melee attack against a random target within range.

actions.name: Enkindle Hate
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Cleaver
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

monster:tob2:herald-of-the-void.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft. (hover), Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob2:herald-of-the-void.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, prone, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Annihilating Form
traits.description: Any object that touches or hits the herald of the Void vaporizes. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to prevent the object from being vaporized. If the object is magical, the creature has advantage on the saving throw. The herald can choose to not vaporize an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the herald fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Zero-Dimensional
traits.description: The herald can move through any space without squeezing.

actions.name: Discorporate (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The herald chooses up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become intangible until the end of its next turn. While intangible, the creature is incapacitated, drops whatever it's holding, and is unable to interact with physical objects. The creature is still visible and able to speak.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald makes two void claw attacks. Alternatively, it can use its Void Ray twice.

actions.name: Song of Mighty Doom (Costs 3 Actions)
actions.description: The herald emits a cacophonous dirge praising the Void. Each creature other than the herald within 30 feet of the herald and that understands Void Speech gains 10 temporary hp.

actions.name: Void Claw (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The herald makes one void claw attack.

actions.name: Void Ray
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage and 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: The Final Song
actions.description: The herald utters a melody of cosmic doom in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This melody doesn't affect creatures that understand Void Speech.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: The herald flies up to half its flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Void Claw
legendaryActions.description: The herald makes one void claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Discorporate
legendaryActions.description: The herald chooses up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become intangible until the end of its next turn. While intangible, the creature is incapacitated, drops whatever it's holding, and is unable to interact with physical objects. The creature is still visible and able to speak.

legendaryActions.name: Song of Mighty Doom
legendaryActions.description: The herald emits a cacophonous dirge praising the Void. Each creature other than the herald within 30 feet of the herald and that understands Void Speech gains 10 temporary hp.

traits.name: Herd-Hidden (Herd Animal Form Only)
traits.description: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) and Cha (Deception) checks to blend into herd or convince those observing herd it is part of the herd.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: One of the Herd
traits.description: A domesticated herd animal such as a cow horse sheep or chicken that can see the herd skulker treats it as a member of the herd regardless of the form skulker takes. When such an animal sees a herd skulker attack or feed it becomes immune to herd skulker’s One of the Herd for the next 24 hrs acting as it normally would when confronting a predator. Creatures immune to the charmed condition are immune to this.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: Transforms into a Large or smaller domesticated herd animal it can see such as a cow horse sheep or chicken or back into its true canine form. Its statistics other than its size are the same in each form. Reverts on death.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monster:a5e-mm:hezrou.damageResistances: cold, fire, lightning; damage from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Chaotic Evil
traits.description: The hezrou radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hezrou makes one attack with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained  and the hezrou can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The hezrou makes a bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits and the hezrou has not swallowed another creature  the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks from outside the hezrou  it is blinded and restrained  and it takes 17 (5d6) ongoing acid damage while swallowed.

actions.name: If a swallowed creature deals 25 or more damage to the hezrou in a single turn, or if the hezrou dies, the hezrou vomits up the creature
Darkness
actions.description: Magical darkness spreads from a point within 30 feet  filling a 15-foot-radius sphere and spreading around corners. It remains for 1 minute  until the hezrou dismisses it  or until the hezrou uses this ability again. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

reactions.name: Stench
reactions.description: When hit by a melee attack, the hezrou emits a cloud of foul-smelling poison gas in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

monster:bfrd:hezrou.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, Demonic Resilience

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hezrou can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Demonic Resilience
traits.description: The hezrou is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
traits.description: The hezrou can communicate with frogs and toads as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The hezrou's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature is immune to the hezrou's Stench for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hezrou makes one Sticky Tongue attack, one Bite attack, and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the hezrou.

bonusActions.name: Quick Leap
bonusActions.description: The hezrou jumps horizontally up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see without provoking opportunity attacks.

monster:ccdx:hierophant-lich.damageImmunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Levitate
traits.description: As a bonus action, a hierophant lich can rise or descend vertically up to 20 feet and can remain suspended there. This trait works like the levitate spell, except there is no duration, and the lich doesn't need to concentrate to continue levitating each round.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If it has a sacred vessel, a destroyed hierophant lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the vessel.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The lich is an 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The lich has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): guidance, mending, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st Level (4 slots): command, detect magic, protection from evil and good, sanctuary
- 2nd Level (3 slots): blindness/deafness, hold person, silence
- 3rd Level (3 slots): animate dead, dispel magic, spirit guardians
- 4th Level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement, guardian of faith
- 5th Level (1 slot): flame strike

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The hierophant lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Damnation (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The hierophant lich threatens one creature within 10 feet of it with eternal suffering. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the hierophant lich's Damnation for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Unholy Smite (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The heirophant lich uses its Unholy Smite.

legendaryActions.name: Cantrip
legendaryActions.description: The hierophant lich casts a cantrip.

legendaryActions.name: Unholy Smite
legendaryActions.description: The heirophant lich uses its Unholy Smite.

legendaryActions.description: The hierophant lich threatens one creature within 10 feet of it with eternal suffering. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the hierophant lich's Damnation for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ray of Frost
actions.description: (Cantrip; V, S) Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d8) cold damage  and the targets Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the nobles next turn.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: If the noble is wielding a melee weapon and can see their attacker, they add 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: The pugilists AC equals 10 + their Dexterity modifier + their Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pugilist attacks three times with their fists.

actions.name: Fists
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends  the pugilist can't grapple a different target.

actions.name: Pin
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Body Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Haymaker
bonusActions.description: The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

bonusActions.name: Head Shot
bonusActions.description: The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of the pugilists next turn.

reactions.name: Opportune Jab
reactions.description: If a creature attempts to grapple the pugilist, the pugilist attacks that creature with their fists.

traits.name: Gullible
traits.description: The giant makes Insight checks with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant attacks twice with its greatclub.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. In lieu of a rock  the giant can throw a grappled Medium or smaller creature up to 30 feet. On a hit  the target and the thrown creature both take 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a miss  only the thrown creature takes the damage. The thrown creature falls prone in an unoccupied space 5 feet from the target.

actions.name: Greatclub Sweep
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage  is pushed 10 feet away from the giant  and falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Grab
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the giant can't grab another target, and it makes greatclub attacks with advantage against the grappled target.

traits.name: Giant Attributes
traits.description: The hill giant is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

traits.name: Show of Might
traits.description: The hill giant can use STR instead of CHA when making CHA (Intimidation) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Spiked Tree Branch or Rotten Snack attacks.

actions.name: Spiked Tree Branch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rotten Snack
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Body Bounce
bonusActions.description: The hill giant bumps its stomach, hip, shoulder, knee, or other part of its body into a creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

traits.description: The giant makes Insight checks with disadvantage.

On a miss  only the thrown creature takes the damage. The thrown creature falls prone in an unoccupied space 5 feet from the target.

bonusActions.name: Body Slam
bonusActions.description: The giant jumps up to 15 feet horizontally without provoking opportunity attacks and falls prone in a space containing one or more creatures. Each creature in its space when it lands makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure. On a success, the creature takes half damage and is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of its choice. If that space is occupied, the creature falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Muddy Ground
bonusActions.description: Areas of unworked earth within 60 feet magically become swampy mud for 1 minute or until the giant dies. These areas become difficult terrain. Prone creatures in the area when the mud appears or that fall prone in the area make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creatures Speed drops to 0 as it becomes stuck in the mud. A creature can use its action to make a DC 15 Strength check, freeing itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Stomp
bonusActions.description: The giant stamps its foot, causing the ground to tremble. Each creature within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it falls prone.

traits.name: Aura of Misfortune
traits.description: Creatures within 15 ft. of it treat attack rolls of 20 as 19 and can’t gain advantage on ability checks attacks and saves.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: While hinderling curse remains on a victim a slain hinderling returns to life in 1 day regaining all its hp and becoming active again. Hinderling appears within 100' of victim.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Run and Hide
reactions.description: When a creature hinderling can see targets it with weapon hinderling chooses another creature within 5 ft. as attack's target then moves up to half its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

monster:bfrd:hinn.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The hinn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the hinn doesn't disturb the material through which it moves.

traits.name: Nebulous (Cloud Form Only)
traits.description: The hinn's Stealth is 20, it can hover while flying, can't manipulate objects or attack, and it can pass through any space air can pass through without squeezing. In addition, it can enter and hide in any Tiny or larger container, such as a pouch, lamp, backpack, or barrel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hinn makes three Gem-Studded Mace or Lob Stone attacks. If two Gem-Studded Mace attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Gem-Studded Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6+6) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lob Stone
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Create Earth Elemental
actions.description: The hinn magically creates one earth-based Elemental of CR 5 or lower in an unoccupied space the hinn can see within 30 feet of it. The elemental acts as an ally of the hinn, obeying its spoken commands. The elemental remains for 1 hour, until the hinn dies, or until the hinn dismisses it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Travel the Planes
actions.description: The hinn transports itself to a different plane of existence. This works like the plane shift spell, except it can affect only itself and can't use this action to banish an unwilling creature.

bonusActions.name: Churned Earth
bonusActions.description: The hinn causes the ground on a point it can see within 60 feet of it to erupt. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Genie Shape
bonusActions.description: The hinn magically transforms into a Medium cloud of dust filled with miniscule clashing, bursting, and reforming rocks or back into its bipedal form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its bipedal form if it dies. The hinn can't use this bonus action to transform into its bipedal form while inside a Medium or smaller container.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hippocampus can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Shared Breath
traits.description: The hippocampus's gills pull more air from the water than the hippocampus needs, expelling the excess as bubbles down its neck and across its back. If an air-breathing creature is riding the hippocampus, these bubbles can provide that creature a supply of fresh air when the hippocampus isn't in combat or traveling at a fast pace.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hippocampus makes one Bite attack and one Tail Slap attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Rearing Kick
bonusActions.description: The hippocampus rears up and kicks its forelegs at one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be knocked prone or pushed up to 10 feet away from the hippocampus (the hippocampus's choice).

monster:a5e-mm:hippogriff.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: The hippogriff has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

monster:bfrd:hippogriff.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Heightened Sight
traits.description: The hippogriff's Perception is 18 when perceiving by sight.

traits.name: Monstrosity Resilience
traits.description: The hippogriff is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hippogriff makes one Beak attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Dive
bonusActions.description: While flying, the hippogriff dives onto a creature below it. The hippogriff moves at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a creature it can see. The target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: Knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Divine Jaws
traits.description: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with Gore Gore deals extra 2d8 necrotic or radiant (included) hippo’s choice.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 30 min.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Sacred Guardian
traits.description: Can pinpoint the location of an agent or worshiper of an opposing deity or a creature with ill intent toward its sacred site within 120' of itself. In addition it can sense when such a creature moves within 100' of the site and can sense general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of the site.

bonusActions.name: Protector's Step
bonusActions.description: Magically teleports with any items worn/carried up to 120' to unoccupied space within its sacred site or within 30' of exterior of its site. Golden light swirls or inky shadown tendrils (hippo's choice) appear at origin and destination.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.description: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find or track a creature that doesn’t have all its hp.

bonusActions.name: Hidden Predator
bonusActions.description: Takes the Hide action.

monster:bfrd:hivebound.speed: 25 ft., Climb 12 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 12 ft.

traits.name: Collective Mind
traits.description: The hivebound's individual insects and swarms under its control are connected via a hive mind.
